learning_objective: 🎯 To understand that hard work, patience, and dedication are the real magic that leads to success, not shortcuts or potions!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Rama Natha wanted to be rich without working. He spent all his time searching for a magic potion that could turn everyday things into shiny gold.
A smart sage told him he needed five litres of winter dew collected from banana leaves to create the magic potion. Excited, Rama Natha started planting banana trees.
For six long years, Rama Natha worked tirelessly in his banana plantation. He carefully collected the dew drop by drop, while his smart wife sold the grown bananas in the market.
When the dew did not turn copper into gold, the sage showed Rama Natha the heavy box of money earned from selling bananas. Rama Natha finally realized that his own hard work was the true magic.

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Become a Wise Sage!
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine your friend wants a magic spell to get full marks in English without studying. Write a short, funny advice telling them what the real magic is!

quick_recap: ⭐ Rama Natha believed in magic potions instead of working hard.
⭐ A wise sage gave him a clever task to collect dew from banana leaves.
⭐ By growing bananas to collect dew, he accidentally built a successful and rich farming business.
⭐ He learned a life lesson that hard work and patience are the true secrets to success.
